dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge forming a smooth inward-curving spline from the posterior dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Bluntly rounded apex characterized by an obtuse pixel curvature.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderate diagonal incline relative to the longitudinal axis of the dorsal surface.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The horizontal pixel width at the base is approximately 1.5 times the maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Uniform convex arc defining the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered protrusion extending from the melon; the visible length is approximately twice its base thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse angle where the melon curvature transitions into the dorsal bridge of the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform monochromatic cyan surface coloration with faceted shading indicative of a digital 3D model rather than biological tissue.
